# Bali Belly Recovery

> On-call Bali Belly medical service for selected areas of Bali. A doctor and nurse visit your villa, hotel or holiday rental. Home-visit requests are accepted 24/7; each visit is subject to address confirmation, clinical assessment and team availability. This is a home-visit service, not a walk-in clinic and not an emergency service.

Key facts
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 896 7009 8140 (send a location pin and your symptoms), balibellyrecovery@gmail.com
- Service: doctor and nurse home visit, doctor assessment, IV drip and medication when the doctor judges them appropriate, and a medical report for travel-insurance claim support. An IV drip is not given to every patient.
- Packages: 16 options in two groups, B-Complex (8, normal prices Rp 2.025.000 to Rp 2.749.706) and Multivitamin (8, normal prices Rp 2.966.176 to Rp 3.690.882). Any current offer is shown on the website and confirmed when booking.
- Areas (15): Canggu, Kerobokan & Umalas, Dalung, Seminyak, Legian, Kuta, Munggu & Cemagi, Kedungu & Tanah Lot, Tabanan, Uluwatu & Pecatu, Jimbaran, Nusa Dua & Benoa, Sanur, Denpasar, Ubud.
- Payment: Wise, Visa, Mastercard.
- Emergencies: go to the nearest emergency room for fainting, confusion, blood in stool or vomit, severe or worsening abdominal pain, very high fever, or inability to keep fluids down.
- Terminology: "Bali Belly" is the traveller's name for diarrhoea and stomach upset during a stay in Bali, medically usually traveller's diarrhoea. "Bali Bally" is a common misspelling.
- Full detail for AI assistants: https://balibellyrecovery.com/llms-full.txt
